pr_title: planner: push avg & distinct functions across union
pr_body:
<!-- Thank you for contributing to TiDB!

PR Title Format:
1. pkg [, pkg2, pkg3]: what's changed
2. *: what's changed

-->

### What problem does this PR solve?

Issue Number: close #16290, close #16292  <!-- REMOVE this line if no issue to close -->

Problem Summary:
1. currently when set `tidb_opt_agg_push_down` to `1`, TiDB does not handle avg & distinct functions across Union but probably forget to call [`isDecomposable`](https://github.com/pingcap/tidb/blob/e07dd4ad7f938c2c49d31d077bd2ba6518321719/planner/core/rule_aggregation_push_down.go#L36) to disable them.
2. The implementation of partition table depends on Union, so that we should support pushing distinct functions across Union, for better performance.

### What is changed and how it works?

Proposal: [xxx](url) <!-- REMOVE this line if not applicable -->

What's Changed:
1. For simplicity, `avg` function is split into `count` and `sum` no matter the partial aggregation is in `TiKV` or not (Before this PR, `avg` function is pushed as `avg` to `TiKV` but split into `count` and `sum` to `TiFlash`). So this logic can be unified into `BuildFinalModeAggregation`.
2. Reuse `BuildFinalModeAggregation` in `aggregationPushDownSolver`, to handle `avg` & `distinct` functions

How it Works:

### Related changes


- Need to cherry-pick to the release branch
    - For 4.0, cherry-pick this PR
    - For older versions, call [`isDecomposable`](https://github.com/pingcap/tidb/blob/e07dd4ad7f938c2c49d31d077bd2ba6518321719/planner/core/rule_aggregation_push_down.go#L36) to disable them.

issue_context.title: runtime error with avg function when set tidb_opt_agg_push_down = 1
issue_context.body:
## Bug Report

Please answer these questions before submitting your issue. Thanks!

### 1. What did you do?

<!-- If possible, provide a recipe for reproducing the error. -->

```mysql
mysql> create table ta(a int);
Query OK, 0 rows affected (0.01 sec)

mysql> insert into ta values(1), (1);
Query OK, 2 rows affected (0.00 sec)
Records: 2  Duplicates: 0  Warnings: 0

mysql> create table tb(a int);
Query OK, 0 rows affected (0.01 sec)

mysql> insert into tb values(1), (1);
Query OK, 2 rows affected (0.00 sec)
Records: 2  Duplicates: 0  Warnings: 0
```

### 2. What did you expect to see?

```mysql
mysql> select avg(a) from (select * from ta union all select * from tb) t;
+--------+
| avg(a) |
+--------+
| 1.0000 |
+--------+
1 row in set (0.00 sec)
```

### 3. What did you see instead?

```mysql
mysql> set session tidb_opt_agg_push_down = 1;
Query OK, 0 rows affected (0.00 sec)

mysql> select avg(a) from (select * from ta union all select * from tb) t;
ERROR 1105 (HY000): runtime error: index out of range [1] with length 1
```

### 4. What version of TiDB are you using? (`tidb-server -V` or run `select tidb_version();` on TiDB)

master (496cb870d)
